svg.title: GEO-02: claims, official accounts and physical evidence
svg.desc: Editorial method diagram. Iran's targeting claim and Bahrain's interception account are distinct from independently confirmed physical outcomes. Sources are linked in the case article; this is not operational imagery.

g.text: A claim is not a damage report.
Dated sources · Contrary evidence · Provisional scenarios remain unscored
Source-linked editorial diagram; no imagery of a verified strike or destruction.
